label: J2 of the modal join: derivation from no novel edge, coverage routes and the mutual-support price
summary:
Target: J2 of the modal spine's join (STMT-CONCRETE-NECESSARY-UNION-WF, well-founded cross-world union of support among necessary concreta), consumed by NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks and NecessaryConcreteUnderivedFromNecessity.underived toward STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-UNDERIVED-AT, and its recorded rival, mutual support of two necessary concreta each at some admitted world. Analyst formulations, attribution deferred; no source read or claimed.

Rival's positive account. Two shapes. (i) Same-world symmetric co-dependence (interdependence of necessary beings): excluded at the selected world already by the join's own ActualGroundingWF; not excluded at other worlds. (ii) World-relative direction: the necessary beings exist everywhere but which sustains which is contingent, so grounding facts about necessary beings are contingent while their existence is not. The recorded model mutualPair is of shape (ii). Objection status under the substantive objection standard (owner direction 2026-11-12): the rival names J2 and a definite mechanism (a cross-world cycle in the support union), but no independent justification is recorded that support between necessary concrete beings ever circles or reverses between worlds; the interdependence label is not an argument and no source was read. It is therefore a formal alternative, not a substantive objection. No substantive objection to J2, no-novel-edge or coverage is recorded. The finite models show which premise a theorem needs in one interpretation, not that any premise is doubtful.

Verified (Comparator and NanoDa pass on each; all but the controls zero-axiom): (1) unionWFOfNoNovel: reflexive access at w, ActualGroundingWF at w (both already join premises) and the existing one-way no-novel-edge condition STMT-NO-NOVEL-NECESSARY-SUPPORT on the concrete subtype give J2; composes union_wellFounded_of_actual_wellFounded via a new lemma that actual grounding well-foundedness makes present support well-founded. (2) mutualSupportExcluded: the same three premises exclude the rival. (3) underivedOfCoverage: concrete population, ActualGroundingWF, every contingent concretum grounded, excluded middle and the new open premise coverage (a necessary concretum supported by an existing concretum at some admitted world is supported by some existing concretum at w) give the join's endpoint with no J1, J2 or reflexive access; the witness is the actual necessary root of necessaryActualRootOfGrounded. (4) underivedFromNecessityOfCoverage: from STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT, ActualGroundingWF, J1 (used only at w), coverage and excluded middle, the endpoint without J2 or reflexive access. (5) coverageOfNoContingentNoNovel: reflexive access, J1 and no-novel-edge give coverage. (6) coverageOfSupportIsPresent: the existing STMT-NECESSARY-SUPPORT-IS-PRESENT gives coverage. (7) controls: rotating triangle (three worlds, support rotates t0->t1->t2->t0 one edge per world): no reversed pair among necessary concreta, well-founded support at every world and every other premise of checks hold, yet J2, the endpoint and coverage fail; so per-world well-foundedness everywhere and the negation of the rival are each insufficient. Rooted pair: the rival, per-world well-foundedness everywhere, every other premise of checks and coverage hold, J2, no-novel-edge and same-supporter presence fail, and the endpoint holds; so the rival is compatible with the join's conclusion, and J2, no-novel-edge and presence are each stronger than the endpoint needs, coverage strictly weaker than both bridges. Uncovered edge: every premise of checks including J1 and J2 and its endpoint hold while coverage and no-novel-edge fail; so J1+J2 do not imply coverage and no-novel-edge is strictly stronger than J2 given reflexive access and ActualGroundingWF.

Price of the rival, checked: given the join's other premises, a holder of mutual support must deny no-novel-edge (some support edge between two necessary concreta holds at another world but not at w); and the rival defeats the endpoint only if the actual necessary root itself is supported elsewhere, which denies coverage: a necessary concretum standing with no concrete supporter at w is sustained by another elsewhere, so its being sustained makes no difference to where it exists. Only an account that lets a necessary concretum lack every actual concrete supporter while having one elsewhere pays that price (no independently motivated account of this kind is recorded); contingency of individual grounding edges alone does not (Control.rootedPair has world-varying edges and satisfies coverage). Essence-based dependence accounts (dependence of one necessary being on another flows from its essence, so holds wherever both exist) give no-novel-edge and, with F1 and J1, coverage. Semantic grounding of coverage: ordinary meaning, orientation example, forbidden pattern and structural properties are in the coverage definition 7266f604-f0bc-4aac-89b9-0f4cc7be5f33; generalization from ordinary sustaining to necessary beings is an explicit open bridge.

Proposed provisional judgment (coordinator to issue after independent semantic challenge): the coverage routes are a better-motivated support option for the join than J2, because J2 is a global cross-world graph condition without a direct ordinary meaning while coverage states a local feature of support; but coverage remains open, the rival survives by denying it, and no premise is established. Computed frontier-diff at base 66e0a74a0 (root STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE): open root-reaching premises 421 -> 422 (bare 282 -> 283), support alternatives 303 -> 308, J2 moved bare -> closed (derived from open premises, not established), bare added STMT-NO-NOVEL-NECESSARY-SUPPORT and STMT-NECESSARY-SUPPORT-IS-PRESENT, lowest route cost 16 -> 16. With root STMT-GOD-EXISTS: 267 -> 268, support alternatives 207 -> 212, cost 6 -> 6.
blocker: Coverage and no-novel-edge remain OPEN. Next tests: (1) warrant for coverage against accounts that let a necessary concretum lack every actual concrete supporter while having one elsewhere, and whether an essence-based dependence account that implies coverage is available without presupposing the endpoint; (2) whether J1 can be weakened to its selected-world instance in underivedFromNecessityOfCoverage (only that instance is used) and registered as a weaker sibling; (3) whether the ungrounded witness of underivedOfCoverage (the actual necessary root itself) is the root NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive starts from (spine item 3, other owner).
